label: twitter-vision-bridge-complete
context:
Twitter Vision Bridge fully operational. Two-layer architecture:
1. ~/subconscious/twitter_bridge.py — GraphQL API fetches text, links, engagement from @tek_nium and @NousResearch. 38 tweets. Cookie auth working.
2. ~/subconscious/twitter_vision_bridge.py — GLM-5V-turbo (glm-5v-turbo model on open.bigmodel.cn) analyzes tweet images. 7 images analyzed in test run.
